```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(gstat)
library(ranger)
library(yardstick)
library(tidyterra)
library(beepr)
dir.create("../outputs/spatial", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
# Load covariate stack
cov_stack <- terra::rast("../data/spatial/covariate_stack_3m_all_with_SR_indices.tif")
cat("Layers:", terra::nlyr(cov_stack), "\n")
cat("CRS:", terra::crs(cov_stack, describe = TRUE)$name, "\n")
print(names(cov_stack))

# Load pedon points
soil_pts_raw <- sf::st_read("../data/spatial/perry_full_locs.shp", quiet = TRUE)
cat("N points:", nrow(soil_pts_raw), "\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(names(soil_pts_raw), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("CRS:", sf::st_crs(soil_pts_raw)$input, "\n")
```

```{r reproject-and-align}
# Reproject points to raster CRS and standardize Point ID
soil_pts <- soil_pts_raw %>%
  sf::st_transform(crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(cov_stack))) %>%
  rename(Point = Point_ID) %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(Point))

cat("Points reprojected.\n")
cat("Point examples:", paste(head(soil_pts$Point, 5), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("N points:", nrow(soil_pts), "\n")
```

```{r extract-covariates}
# Extract covariate values at pedon locations
cov_at_pedons <- terra::extract(
  cov_stack,
  terra::vect(soil_pts),
  ID = TRUE,
  bind = FALSE
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(soil_pts$Point[ID])) %>%
  select(-ID) %>%
  relocate(Point)

cat("Extracted rows:", nrow(cov_at_pedons), "\n")
cat("Point examples:", paste(head(cov_at_pedons$Point, 5), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Report missing values
cov_at_pedons %>%
  select(-Point) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "covariate", values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  filter(n_missing > 0) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()

write.csv(cov_at_pedons,
          "../outputs/spatial/covariates_at_pedons.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r build-model-df}
# Load Perry horizon data for series truth
perry_fp_clean <- read.csv("../data/Perry_FP_data_with_taxa_02_20_2026.csv") %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(Point))

# Build one series label per pedon (modal non-NA value)
perry_series_truth <- perry_fp_clean %>%
  mutate(
    series = na_if(str_squish(as.character(series_clean)), ""),
    series = na_if(series, "Fill"),
    series = na_if(series, "fill"),
    series = str_to_title(series)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Point) %>%
  summarise(
    series = {
      y <- series[!is.na(series)]
      if (length(y) == 0) NA_character_
      else names(sort(table(y), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Series truth Points:", paste(head(perry_series_truth$Point, 5), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Covariate Points:   ", paste(head(cov_at_pedons$Point, 5), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Matching points:", sum(cov_at_pedons$Point %in% perry_series_truth$Point), "\n")

# Join covariates + series truth, filter to series with >= 3 pedons
model_df <- cov_at_pedons %>%
  left_join(perry_series_truth, by = "Point") %>%
  filter(!is.na(series)) %>%
  add_count(series, name = "series_n") %>%
  filter(series_n >= 3) %>%
  select(-series_n) %>%
  mutate(series = factor(series))

# Join XY coordinates for kriging
pts_xy <- soil_pts %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  bind_cols(
    st_coordinates(soil_pts) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(coord_X = X, coord_Y = Y)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(Point)) %>%
  select(Point, coord_X, coord_Y)

model_df <- model_df %>%
  left_join(pts_xy, by = "Point")

cat("\nFinal model_df:\n")
cat("  Rows:", nrow(model_df), "\n")
cat("  Series:\n")
model_df %>%
  mutate(series = as.character(series)) %>%
  count(series, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()

# Diagnostic if join still failing
if (nrow(model_df) == 0) {
  cat("\nDIAGNOSTIC:\n")
  cat("cov_at_pedons Points: ", paste(head(cov_at_pedons$Point, 10), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("perry_series_truth Points:", paste(head(perry_series_truth$Point, 10), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r train-test-split}
# ============================================================
# TRAIN / TEST SPLIT (random 80/20, stratified by series)
# ============================================================

set.seed(42)

split_spatial <- initial_split(model_df, prop = 0.8, strata = series)
train_spatial <- training(split_spatial)
test_spatial  <- testing(split_spatial)

cat("Train:", nrow(train_spatial), "| Test:", nrow(test_spatial), "\n")
cat("Test series distribution:\n")
test_spatial %>%
  mutate(series = as.character(series)) %>%
  count(series, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()
```

```{r spatial-rf}
# ============================================================
# STAGE 2: SPATIAL RANDOM FOREST
# Train RF on spatial covariates -> series at Perry pedon locations
# ============================================================

set.seed(43)

# Predictor columns = all covariate columns (not Point, series, coords)
cov_cols <- setdiff(names(train_spatial),
                    c("Point", "series", "coord_X", "coord_Y"))

# Remove any zero-variance or all-NA columns
cov_cols <- cov_cols[
  vapply(train_spatial[cov_cols],
         function(x) length(unique(x[is.finite(x)])) > 1, logical(1))
]

cat("Using", length(cov_cols), "covariate predictors\n")

# Recipe
rec_spatial <- recipe(series ~ ., data = train_spatial %>%
                         select(all_of(c("series", cov_cols)))) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

# RF spec with tuning
rf_spatial_spec <- rand_forest(
  trees = 1000,
  mtry  = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf_spatial <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spatial_spec) %>%
  add_recipe(rec_spatial)

min_class_n <- train_spatial %>%
  count(series) %>%
  summarise(mn = min(n)) %>%
  pull(mn)

v_folds <- max(2, min(5, min_class_n))

folds_spatial <- vfold_cv(
  train_spatial %>% select(all_of(c("series", cov_cols))),
  v = v_folds,
  strata = series
)

p <- length(cov_cols)
grid_spatial <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, min(15, p))),
  min_n(range = c(2, 20)),
  levels = 4
)

cat("Tuning spatial RF ...\n")
tuned_spatial <- tune_grid(
  wf_spatial,
  resamples = folds_spatial,
  grid      = grid_spatial,
  metrics   = metric_set(kap, accuracy)
)

best_spatial <- select_best(tuned_spatial, metric = "kap")
cat("Best spatial RF params:\n"); print(best_spatial)

rf_spatial_final <- finalize_workflow(wf_spatial, best_spatial) %>%
  fit(train_spatial %>% select(all_of(c("series", cov_cols))))

# ---- Test set evaluation ----
pred_spatial_rf <- predict(
  rf_spatial_final,
  test_spatial %>% select(all_of(cov_cols)),
  type = "prob"
) %>%
  bind_cols(
    predict(rf_spatial_final,
            test_spatial %>% select(all_of(cov_cols)),
            type = "class")
  ) %>%
  bind_cols(test_spatial %>% select(Point, series, coord_X, coord_Y))

cat("\n--- SPATIAL RF TEST SET METRICS ---\n")
metrics_spatial_rf <- metric_set(accuracy, kap)(
  pred_spatial_rf,
  truth    = series,
  estimate = .pred_class
)
print(metrics_spatial_rf)

f1_spatial_rf <- f_meas(
  pred_spatial_rf,
  truth     = series,
  estimate  = .pred_class,
  estimator = "macro"
)
print(f1_spatial_rf)

cat("\nPer-class accuracy:\n")
pred_spatial_rf %>%
  mutate(across(c(series, .pred_class), as.character)) %>%
  group_by(series) %>%
  summarise(
    n         = n(),
    n_correct = sum(series == .pred_class),
    acc       = round(n_correct / n, 2),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(acc)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()

# Save spatial RF bundle
saveRDS(
  list(
    name      = "taxseries_spatial_rf",
    outcome   = "series",
    cov_cols  = cov_cols,
    final_fit = rf_spatial_final,
    metrics   = metrics_spatial_rf,
    f_meas    = f1_spatial_rf
  ),
  "../outputs/models/taxseries_spatial_rf_bundle.rds"
)
```

```{r variogram-kriging}
# ============================================================
# STAGE 3: REGRESSION KRIGING ON RF RESIDUALS
# ============================================================
# Strategy: for each series, krige the residual of the RF
# predicted probability vs. observed (1/0). The kriged
# correction surface is added to the RF probability map.
# ============================================================

# Get predicted probabilities for ALL training pedons (for variogram fitting)
prob_cols <- names(predict(rf_spatial_final,
                           train_spatial %>% select(all_of(cov_cols)),
                           type = "prob"))

train_probs <- predict(
  rf_spatial_final,
  train_spatial %>% select(all_of(cov_cols)),
  type = "prob"
) %>%
  bind_cols(train_spatial %>% select(Point, series, coord_X, coord_Y))

# For each series, compute residual = observed indicator - predicted probability
series_levels <- levels(model_df$series)

# We will krige residuals for each series separately
variogram_fits <- list()
krige_models   <- list()

for (s in series_levels) {

  prob_col <- paste0(".pred_", s)
  if (!prob_col %in% names(train_probs)) next

  resid_df <- train_probs %>%
    mutate(
      observed = as.integer(as.character(series) == s),
      residual = observed - .data[[prob_col]]
    ) %>%
    select(coord_X, coord_Y, residual) %>%
    filter(is.finite(residual))

  if (nrow(resid_df) < 5) next

  # Convert to sf for gstat
  resid_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
    resid_df,
    coords = c("coord_X", "coord_Y"),
    crs    = sf::st_crs(soil_pts)
  )

  # Fit empirical variogram
  vgm_emp <- tryCatch(
    gstat::variogram(residual ~ 1, data = resid_sf),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(vgm_emp)) next

  # Fit theoretical variogram model (try Sph, fall back to Exp)
  vgm_fit <- tryCatch(
    gstat::fit.variogram(vgm_emp, gstat::vgm(c("Sph", "Exp"))),
    error = function(e) tryCatch(
      gstat::fit.variogram(vgm_emp, gstat::vgm("Exp")),
      error = function(e2) NULL
    )
  )

  if (is.null(vgm_fit)) next

  variogram_fits[[s]] <- list(empirical = vgm_emp, fitted = vgm_fit)
  krige_models[[s]]   <- list(data = resid_sf, vgm = vgm_fit)

  cat("Variogram fitted for series:", s, "\n")
  cat("  Model:", vgm_fit$model[2], 
      "| Range:", round(vgm_fit$range[2], 1),
      "| Sill:", round(vgm_fit$psill[2], 4), "\n")
}

# ---- Plot variograms ----
for (s in names(variogram_fits)) {
  p <- plot(
    variogram_fits[[s]]$empirical,
    variogram_fits[[s]]$fitted,
    main = paste("Variogram:", s)
  )
  print(p)
}
```

```{r wall-to-wall-prediction}
# ============================================================
# STAGE 4: WALL-TO-WALL PREDICTION
# ============================================================

cat("Predicting across full raster extent...\n")
cat("This may take a few minutes at 3m resolution.\n")

# ---- RF prediction across all pixels ----
# terra::predict handles the raster stack directly
# We need to use the prepped recipe manually for raster prediction

# Extract prep object from workflow
prep_obj <- rf_spatial_final %>%
  extract_preprocessor()

# Build a prediction function compatible with terra::predict
rf_predict_fun <- function(model, newdata, ...) {
  # newdata is a data.frame of pixel values from terra
  newdata_clean <- newdata %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    select(any_of(cov_cols))

  # Replace non-finite with NA then impute
  newdata_clean <- newdata_clean %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))

  probs <- predict(model, new_data = newdata_clean, type = "prob")
  probs
}

# Predict probabilities per pixel for each series
# Use terra::predict with the workflow object
prob_rasters <- terra::predict(
  object  = cov_stack[[cov_cols]],
  model   = rf_spatial_final,
  fun     = function(model, ...) {
    newdata <- list(...)[[1]] %>% as.data.frame()
    names(newdata) <- cov_cols[seq_len(ncol(newdata))]
    newdata[!is.finite(as.matrix(newdata))] <- NA
    predict(model, new_data = newdata, type = "prob")
  },
  na.rm   = TRUE,
  cores   = 1
)

# If terra::predict doesn't cooperate with tidymodels workflow,
# use this safer tile-based approach instead:
if (!exists("prob_rasters") || is.null(prob_rasters)) {

  cat("Falling back to chunk-based prediction...\n")

  # Convert raster to data frame for prediction
  cov_df <- terra::as.data.frame(cov_stack[[cov_cols]], xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)

  # Keep track of which rows are complete
  complete_idx <- complete.cases(cov_df %>% select(-x, -y))

  cov_pred_input <- cov_df %>%
    select(all_of(cov_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))

  # Predict in chunks to avoid memory issues
  chunk_size <- 50000
  n_rows     <- nrow(cov_pred_input)
  n_chunks   <- ceiling(n_rows / chunk_size)

  prob_list <- vector("list", n_chunks)

  cat("Predicting in", n_chunks, "chunks...\n")
  for (i in seq_len(n_chunks)) {
    idx_start <- (i - 1) * chunk_size + 1
    idx_end   <- min(i * chunk_size, n_rows)

    chunk <- cov_pred_input[idx_start:idx_end, ]

    chunk_probs <- tryCatch(
      predict(rf_spatial_final, new_data = chunk, type = "prob"),
      error = function(e) {
        matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(chunk),
               ncol = length(series_levels)) %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          setNames(paste0(".pred_", series_levels))
      }
    )

    prob_list[[i]] <- chunk_probs
    if (i %% 10 == 0) cat("  Chunk", i, "/", n_chunks, "\n")
  }

  all_probs <- bind_rows(prob_list)

  # Reconstruct rasters for each series
  prob_rasters <- terra::rast(cov_stack[[1]])  # template
  prob_rasters <- terra::rast(
    replicate(length(series_levels), terra::rast(cov_stack[[1]]))
  )
  names(prob_rasters) <- paste0("prob_", series_levels)

  for (j in seq_along(series_levels)) {
    s   <- series_levels[j]
    col <- paste0(".pred_", s)
    if (col %in% names(all_probs)) {
      vals <- all_probs[[col]]
      terra::values(prob_rasters[[j]]) <- vals
    }
  }
}

cat("RF probability rasters created.\n")
```

```{r krige-residuals}
# ============================================================
# ADD KRIGED RESIDUAL CORRECTION
# ============================================================

# For each series with a fitted variogram, krige the residuals
# across the full raster extent and add to RF probability

# Build prediction grid from raster extent
raster_pts <- terra::as.data.frame(cov_stack[[1]], xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  select(x, y) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = sf::st_crs(soil_pts))

cat("Kriging residuals for", length(krige_models), "series...\n")

kriged_corrections <- list()

for (s in names(krige_models)) {
  cat("  Kriging:", s, "...\n")

  krige_result <- tryCatch(
    gstat::krige(
      formula  = residual ~ 1,
      locations = krige_models[[s]]$data,
      newdata  = raster_pts,
      model    = krige_models[[s]]$vgm,
      debug.level = 0
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("    Kriging failed for", s, ":", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(krige_result)) next

  # Convert kriged predictions to raster
  krige_vals <- krige_result$var1.pred

  krige_rast <- terra::rast(cov_stack[[1]])
  # Match kriged values back to raster cells
  krige_df <- raster_pts %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    bind_cols(st_coordinates(raster_pts) %>%
                as.data.frame() %>%
                rename(x = X, y = Y)) %>%
    mutate(krige_val = krige_vals)

  cells <- terra::cellFromXY(krige_rast,
                              as.matrix(krige_df %>% select(x, y)))
  terra::values(krige_rast)[cells] <- krige_df$krige_val

  kriged_corrections[[s]] <- krige_rast
  cat("    Done.\n")
}

# ---- Combine RF probabilities + kriged corrections ----
rk_rasters <- prob_rasters  # start with RF probabilities

for (s in names(kriged_corrections)) {
  prob_layer_name <- paste0("prob_", s)
  if (prob_layer_name %in% names(rk_rasters)) {
    # Add kriged correction and clamp to [0, 1]
    corrected <- rk_rasters[[prob_layer_name]] + kriged_corrections[[s]]
    corrected <- terra::clamp(corrected, lower = 0, upper = 1)
    rk_rasters[[prob_layer_name]] <- corrected
  }
}

cat("Regression kriging correction applied.\n")
```

```{r predicted-class-map}
# ============================================================
# FINAL PREDICTED CLASS MAP
# ============================================================

# Predicted class = series with highest probability at each pixel
predicted_class_rast <- terra::which.lyr(rk_rasters)
names(predicted_class_rast) <- "predicted_series_idx"

# Create a lookup: index -> series name
series_lookup_df <- tibble(
  idx    = seq_along(series_levels),
  series = series_levels
)

# Save probability stack
terra::writeRaster(
  rk_rasters,
  "../outputs/spatial/series_probability_stack_rk.tif",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# Save predicted class raster (as integer index)
terra::writeRaster(
  predicted_class_rast,
  "../outputs/spatial/series_predicted_class_rk.tif",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# Save lookup table
write.csv(series_lookup_df,
          "../outputs/spatial/series_index_lookup.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("Saved:\n")
cat("  ../outputs/spatial/series_probability_stack_rk.tif\n")
cat("  ../outputs/spatial/series_predicted_class_rk.tif\n")
cat("  ../outputs/spatial/series_index_lookup.csv\n")
```

```{r visualize}
# ============================================================
# VISUALIZATION
# ============================================================

# ---- 1. Predicted series map ----
# Convert integer raster to factor for plotting
predicted_class_factor <- terra::as.factor(predicted_class_rast)
levels(predicted_class_factor) <- data.frame(
  value = seq_along(series_levels),
  series = series_levels
)

ggplot() +
  tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = predicted_class_factor) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo", na.value = "grey90", name = "Series") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Soil Series — Perry Site",
    subtitle = "Regression Kriging RF (spatial covariates, 3m resolution)"
  )

ggsave("../outputs/spatial/predicted_series_map.png",
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 200)

# ---- 2. Probability maps per series ----
for (s in series_levels) {
  prob_layer <- paste0("prob_", s)
  if (!prob_layer %in% names(rk_rasters)) next

  p <- ggplot() +
    tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = rk_rasters[[prob_layer]]) +
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette  = "RdYlGn",
      direction = 1,
      na.value = "grey90",
      limits   = c(0, 1),
      name     = "Probability"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title    = paste("Predicted probability:", s),
      subtitle = "Regression kriging correction applied"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    paste0("../outputs/spatial/prob_map_", str_replace_all(s, " ", "_"), ".png"),
    plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 200
  )
}

# ---- 3. Validation points overlaid on prediction map ----
test_sf <- test_spatial %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("coord_X", "coord_Y"),
               crs = sf::st_crs(soil_pts))

ggplot() +
  tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = predicted_class_factor) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo", na.value = "grey90",
                       name = "Predicted Series") +
  geom_sf(data = test_sf, aes(shape = as.character(series)),
          size = 3, color = "white", stroke = 1.2) +
  geom_sf(data = test_sf, aes(color = as.character(series),
                               shape = as.character(series)),
          size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = scales::hue_pal()(length(series_levels)),
    name   = "True Series"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = rep(c(16, 17, 15, 18, 8), length.out = length(series_levels)),
    name   = "True Series"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title    = "Predicted Series Map with Validation Points",
    subtitle = "Point shape/color = true series; background = model prediction"
  )

ggsave("../outputs/spatial/predicted_series_validation_overlay.png",
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 200)
```

```{r load-inputs}
# ============================================================
# LOAD ALL INPUTS
# ============================================================

# 1. Covariate stack (already loaded, but reload if fresh session)
if (!exists("cov_stack")) {
  cov_stack <- terra::rast(
```

```{r ncss-predictions-at-pedons}
# ============================================================
# STAGE 1: RUN PERRY PEDONS THROUGH NCSS SERIES RF MODEL
# Get morphology-informed series probabilities at each pedon
# ============================================================

# Helper from deploy script -- pad missing columns to match training data
pad_like_train_raw <- function(new_df, train_df, outcome) {
  req <- setdiff(names(train_df), outcome)
  out <- new_df
  missing <- setdiff(req, names(out))

  for (nm in missing) {
    tmpl <- train_df[[nm]]
    if (str_detect(nm, "^prop_hzbase_")) {
      out[[nm]] <- 0
    } else if (str_detect(nm, "^(any_|has_)")) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.logical(tmpl))  { out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.integer(tmpl))  { out[[nm]] <- NA_integer_
    } else if (is.numeric(tmpl))  { out[[nm]] <- NA_real_
    } else                         { out[[nm]] <- NA_character_ }
  }

  out %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, FALSE))) %>%
    select(any_of(c("peiid", req)))
}

# Add top1/margin helper
add_top1_margin <- function(pred_df) {
  pred_cols <- names(pred_df)[
    str_detect(names(pred_df), "^\\.pred_") & names(pred_df) != ".pred_class"
  ]
  pred_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      probs  = list(c_across(all_of(pred_cols))),
      top1   = max(probs, na.rm = TRUE),
      top2   = ifelse(length(probs) > 1,
                      sort(probs, decreasing = TRUE)[2], NA_real_),
      margin = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, top1 - top2, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-probs)
}

# Pad Perry pack to match NCSS training columns
perry_padded <- pad_like_train_raw(
  new_df   = perry_pack_150 %>% mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid)),
  train_df = ncss_bundle$train_raw,
  outcome  = ncss_bundle$outcome
)

# Force column classes to match training data
for (nm in intersect(names(perry_padded), names(ncss_bundle$train_raw))) {
  tmpl <- ncss_bundle$train_raw[[nm]]
  if (is.integer(tmpl))   perry_padded[[nm]] <- as.integer(perry_padded[[nm]])
  else if (is.logical(tmpl))  perry_padded[[nm]] <- as.logical(perry_padded[[nm]])
  else if (is.numeric(tmpl))  perry_padded[[nm]] <- as.numeric(perry_padded[[nm]])
  else if (is.character(tmpl)) perry_padded[[nm]] <- as.character(perry_padded[[nm]])
  else if (is.factor(tmpl))    perry_padded[[nm]] <- factor(
    as.character(perry_padded[[nm]]), levels = levels(tmpl)
  )
}

# Run NCSS predictions
ncss_probs <- predict(ncss_bundle$final_fit, perry_padded, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(ncss_bundle$final_fit, perry_padded, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(perry_padded %>% select(peiid)) %>%
  add_top1_margin()

cat("NCSS predictions generated for", nrow(ncss_probs), "Perry pedons.\n")
cat("Predicted series distribution:\n")
ncss_probs %>%
  count(.pred_class, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()

# Get probability column names (one per series)
prob_cols <- names(ncss_probs)[str_detect(names(ncss_probs), "^\\.pred_") &
                                 names(ncss_probs) != ".pred_class"]
series_levels <- str_remove(prob_cols, "^\\.pred_")
cat("Series in NCSS model:", paste(series_levels, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r build-bridge-df}
# ============================================================
# BUILD BRIDGE DATASET
# Combine NCSS predictions + spatial covariates at pedon locations
# This is what we train the spatial bridge model on
# ============================================================

# Perry pack has peiid; we need to link to Point (field ID)
# Use the perry_fp_clean Point -> peiid mapping
point_to_peiid <- perry_fp_clean %>%
  select(Point, peiid = Point) %>%   # peiid in perry context = Point
  distinct() #%>%
  # mutate(Point = as.character(Point),
  #        peiid = as.character(peiid))

# Actually perry_pack_150$peiid IS the Point number in Perry context
# Confirm:
cat("perry_pack_150 peiid examples:", 
    paste(head(perry_pack_150$peiid, 5), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("cov_at_pedons Point examples:", 
    paste(head(cov_at_pedons$Point, 5), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Join: ncss_probs (peiid) + covariates (Point) + series truth (Point)
# peiid in perry_pack_150 = Point in soil_pts
bridge_df <- ncss_probs %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(peiid)) %>%
  left_join(cov_at_pedons %>% mutate(Point = as.character(Point)),
            by = "Point") %>%
  left_join(perry_series_truth %>% mutate(Point = as.character(Point)),
            by = "Point") %>%
  mutate(
    series_truth = factor(series),
    ncss_pred    = as.character(.pred_class)
  )

cat("Bridge dataset rows:", nrow(bridge_df), "\n")
cat("Rows with covariate data:", sum(!is.na(bridge_df$elevation)), "\n")
cat("Rows with series truth:", sum(!is.na(bridge_df$series_truth)), "\n")

# XY coordinates for kriging
pts_xy <- soil_pts %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  bind_cols(
    st_coordinates(soil_pts) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(coord_X = X, coord_Y = Y)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(Point)) %>%
  select(Point, coord_X, coord_Y)

bridge_df <- bridge_df %>%
  left_join(pts_xy, by = "Point")

cat("Rows with XY coordinates:", sum(!is.na(bridge_df$coord_X)), "\n")
```

```{r train-test-split}
# ============================================================
# TRAIN / TEST SPLIT
# Use only pedons that have both covariate data AND series truth
# ============================================================

model_ready <- bridge_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(series_truth), !is.na(elevation),
         !is.na(coord_X)) %>%
  droplevels()

cat("Model-ready pedons:", nrow(model_ready), "\n")
cat("Series distribution:\n")
model_ready %>%
  count(series_truth, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()

set.seed(42)
split_bridge <- initial_split(model_ready, prop = 0.8)
train_bridge <- training(split_bridge)
test_bridge  <- testing(split_bridge)

cat("Train:", nrow(train_bridge), "| Test:", nrow(test_bridge), "\n")
```

```{r bridge-rf}
# ============================================================
# STAGE 2: BRIDGE RF MODEL
# Predict series from spatial covariates, informed by NCSS probs
# Two versions:
#   A) covariates only (pure spatial)
#   B) covariates + NCSS predicted probabilities (hybrid)
# ============================================================

cov_cols <- setdiff(names(cov_at_pedons), "Point")

# Remove zero-variance covariates
cov_cols <- cov_cols[
  vapply(train_bridge[cov_cols],
         function(x) length(unique(x[is.finite(x)])) > 1, logical(1))
]

cat("Spatial covariates used:", length(cov_cols), "\n")

# ---- Version A: covariates only ----
rec_cov_only <- recipe(series_truth ~ ., 
                       data = train_bridge %>%
                         select(series_truth, all_of(cov_cols))) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = 1000, mtry = tune(), min_n = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf_cov <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec) %>%
  add_recipe(rec_cov_only)

min_n_train <- train_bridge %>%
  count(series_truth) %>%
  summarise(mn = min(n)) %>%
  pull(mn)

v <- max(2, min(5, min_n_train))

set.seed(43)
folds_cov <- vfold_cv(
  train_bridge %>% select(series_truth, all_of(cov_cols)),
  v = v
)

grid_cov <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, min(15, length(cov_cols)))),
  min_n(range = c(2, 15)),
  levels = 4
)

cat("Tuning covariates-only RF...\n")
tuned_cov <- tune_grid(
  wf_cov,
  resamples = folds_cov,
  grid      = grid_cov,
  metrics   = metric_set(kap, accuracy)
)

best_cov <- select_best(tuned_cov, metric = "kap")
rf_final_cov <- finalize_workflow(wf_cov, best_cov) %>%
  fit(train_bridge %>% select(series_truth, all_of(cov_cols)))

pred_cov <- predict(rf_final_cov,
                    test_bridge %>% select(all_of(cov_cols)),
                    type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(rf_final_cov,
                    test_bridge %>% select(all_of(cov_cols)),
                    type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(test_bridge %>% select(series_truth))

cat("\n--- BRIDGE RF (covariates only) ---\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap)(pred_cov,
                                truth    = series_truth,
                                estimate = .pred_class))
print(f_meas(pred_cov, truth = series_truth,
             estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"))

# ---- Version B: covariates + NCSS probabilities (hybrid) ----
hybrid_cols <- c(cov_cols, prob_cols)

rec_hybrid <- recipe(series_truth ~ .,
                     data = train_bridge %>%
                       select(series_truth, all_of(hybrid_cols))) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

wf_hybrid <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec) %>%
  add_recipe(rec_hybrid)

set.seed(44)
folds_hybrid <- vfold_cv(
  train_bridge %>% select(series_truth, all_of(hybrid_cols)),
  v = v
)

grid_hybrid <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, min(15, length(hybrid_cols)))),
  min_n(range = c(2, 15)),
  levels = 4
)

cat("\nTuning hybrid RF (covariates + NCSS probs)...\n")
tuned_hybrid <- tune_grid(
  wf_hybrid,
  resamples = folds_hybrid,
  grid      = grid_hybrid,
  metrics   = metric_set(kap, accuracy)
)

best_hybrid <- select_best(tuned_hybrid, metric = "kap")
rf_final_hybrid <- finalize_workflow(wf_hybrid, best_hybrid) %>%
  fit(train_bridge %>% select(series_truth, all_of(hybrid_cols)))

pred_hybrid <- predict(rf_final_hybrid,
                       test_bridge %>% select(all_of(hybrid_cols)),
                       type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(rf_final_hybrid,
                    test_bridge %>% select(all_of(hybrid_cols)),
                    type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(test_bridge %>% select(series_truth))

cat("\n--- HYBRID RF (covariates + NCSS probs) ---\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap)(pred_hybrid,
                                truth    = series_truth,
                                estimate = .pred_class))
print(f_meas(pred_hybrid, truth = series_truth,
             estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"))

# Per-class accuracy for best model
cat("\nPer-class accuracy (hybrid):\n")
pred_hybrid %>%
  mutate(across(c(series_truth, .pred_class), as.character)) %>%
  group_by(series_truth) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), n_correct = sum(series_truth == .pred_class),
            acc = round(n_correct / n, 2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(acc)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()
```

```{r variogram-kriging}
# ============================================================
# STAGE 3: REGRESSION KRIGING ON RESIDUALS
# Fit variogram on residuals from the hybrid RF
# ============================================================

# Get predicted probabilities for ALL training pedons
train_probs_hybrid <- predict(
  rf_final_hybrid,
  train_bridge %>% select(all_of(hybrid_cols)),
  type = "prob"
) %>%
  bind_cols(train_bridge %>% select(Point, series_truth, coord_X, coord_Y))

variogram_fits <- list()
krige_models   <- list()

for (s in series_levels) {
  prob_col <- paste0(".pred_", s)
  if (!prob_col %in% names(train_probs_hybrid)) next

  resid_df <- train_probs_hybrid %>%
    mutate(
      observed = as.integer(as.character(series_truth) == s),
      residual = observed - .data[[prob_col]]
    ) %>%
    select(coord_X, coord_Y, residual) %>%
    filter(is.finite(residual))

  if (nrow(resid_df) < 5) {
    cat("Skipping", s, "-- fewer than 5 training points.\n")
    next
  }

  resid_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(resid_df,
                            coords = c("coord_X", "coord_Y"),
                            crs    = sf::st_crs(soil_pts))

  vgm_emp <- tryCatch(
    gstat::variogram(residual ~ 1, data = resid_sf),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(vgm_emp)) next

  vgm_fit <- tryCatch(
    gstat::fit.variogram(vgm_emp, gstat::vgm(c("Sph", "Exp"))),
    error = function(e) tryCatch(
      gstat::fit.variogram(vgm_emp, gstat::vgm("Exp")),
      error = function(e2) NULL
    )
  )
  if (is.null(vgm_fit)) next

  variogram_fits[[s]] <- list(empirical = vgm_emp, fitted = vgm_fit)
  krige_models[[s]]   <- list(data = resid_sf, vgm = vgm_fit)

  cat("Variogram fitted:", s,
      "| Model:", vgm_fit$model[2],
      "| Range:", round(vgm_fit$range[2], 1), "\n")
}

# Plot variograms
for (s in names(variogram_fits)) {
  p <- plot(variogram_fits[[s]]$empirical,
            variogram_fits[[s]]$fitted,
            main = paste("Variogram:", s))
  print(p)
}
```

```{r wall-to-wall}
# ============================================================
# STAGE 4: WALL-TO-WALL PREDICTION
# ============================================================

cat("Converting raster to data frame for prediction...\n")

# Get NCSS predicted probabilities for ALL Perry pedons
# (not just the model-ready subset)
ncss_probs_all <- ncss_probs %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(peiid)) %>%
  select(Point, all_of(prob_cols))

# Build full pixel data frame from raster
cov_df <- terra::as.data.frame(cov_stack[[cov_cols]], xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)
n_pixels <- nrow(cov_df)
cat("Total pixels:", n_pixels, "\n")

# For hybrid prediction we need NCSS probs at every pixel.
# We don't have morphology data at every pixel, so we use
# spatial interpolation of NCSS probs from pedon locations.
# Simple approach: krige each NCSS probability surface from pedons.

cat("Interpolating NCSS probabilities across raster extent...\n")

# Prediction grid
pred_grid <- terra::as.data.frame(cov_stack[[1]], xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  select(x, y) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = sf::st_crs(soil_pts))

# Interpolate each NCSS probability surface
ncss_prob_rasters <- list()

# Join probs to spatial points
ncss_pts_sf <- soil_pts %>%
  left_join(ncss_probs_all, by = "Point")

# Replace the interpolation loop's raster-building with this approach:
for (prob_col in prob_cols) {
  s <- str_remove(prob_col, "^\\.pred_")
  
  pts_s <- ncss_pts_sf %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[prob_col]])) %>%
    rename(prob_val = all_of(prob_col))
  
  if (nrow(pts_s) < 3) next
  
  # IDW interpolation
  idw_result <- tryCatch(
    gstat::idw(prob_val ~ 1, locations = pts_s,
               newdata = pred_grid, idp = 2, debug.level = 0),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(idw_result)) next
  
  # Convert result to raster using rasterize instead of cellFromXY
  idw_sf <- idw_result %>%
    mutate(interp_val = pmax(0, pmin(1, var1.pred))) %>%
    select(interp_val)
  
  r <- terra::rasterize(
    terra::vect(idw_sf),
    cov_stack[[1]],
    field = "interp_val",
    fun   = "mean"
  )
  names(r) <- prob_col
  ncss_prob_rasters[[prob_col]] <- r
  cat("Interpolated:", s, "\n")
}

# Then rebuild the stack only from non-empty rasters
ncss_prob_rasters <- Filter(
  function(r) !all(is.na(terra::values(r))), 
  ncss_prob_rasters
)
ncss_prob_stack <- terra::rast(ncss_prob_rasters)
cat("NCSS prob stack layers:", terra::nlyr(ncss_prob_stack), "\n")
# Build probability raster stack from chunk predictions
prob_raster_list <- list()

for (j in seq_along(series_levels)) {
  col <- paste0(".pred_", series_levels[j])
  if (!col %in% names(all_probs)) next
  
  r <- terra::rast(cov_stack[[1]])  # fresh template
  terra::values(r) <- all_probs[[col]]
  names(r) <- paste0("prob_", series_levels[j])
  
  if (!all(is.na(terra::values(r)))) {
    prob_raster_list[[series_levels[j]]] <- r
  }
}

prob_rasters <- terra::rast(prob_raster_list)
cat("Probability raster layers:", terra::nlyr(prob_rasters), "\n")
cat("Layer names:", paste(names(prob_rasters), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r krige-correction}
# ============================================================
# ADD KRIGED RESIDUAL CORRECTION TO PROBABILITY RASTERS
# ============================================================

if (length(krige_models) > 0) {

  pred_grid_krige <- terra::as.data.frame(
    cov_stack[[1]], xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE
  ) %>%
    select(x, y) %>%
    sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = sf::st_crs(soil_pts))

  for (s in names(krige_models)) {
    cat("Kriging residuals for:", s, "...\n")

    krige_result <- tryCatch(
      gstat::krige(
        formula   = residual ~ 1,
        locations = krige_models[[s]]$data,
        newdata   = pred_grid_krige,
        model     = krige_models[[s]]$vgm,
        debug.level = 0
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("  Kriging failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (is.null(krige_result)) next

    # Build correction raster
    krige_rast <- terra::rast(cov_stack[[1]])
    cells <- terra::cellFromXY(
      krige_rast,
      st_coordinates(pred_grid_krige) %>% as.matrix()
    )
    terra::values(krige_rast)[cells] <- krige_result$var1.pred

    # Apply correction and clamp
    layer_nm <- paste0("prob_", s)
    if (layer_nm %in% names(prob_rasters)) {
      corrected <- terra::clamp(
        prob_rasters[[layer_nm]] + krige_rast,
        lower = 0, upper = 1
      )
      prob_rasters[[layer_nm]] <- corrected
      cat("  Correction applied:", s, "\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("No variogram models fitted -- skipping kriging correction.\n")
}

# ---- Final classified map ----
predicted_class_idx <- terra::which.lyr(prob_rasters)
names(predicted_class_idx) <- "predicted_series_idx"

series_lookup_df <- tibble(
  idx    = seq_along(series_levels),
  series = series_levels
)

# Save outputs
terra::writeRaster(prob_rasters,
                   "../outputs/spatial/series_prob_stack_hybrid_rk.tif",
                   overwrite = TRUE)
terra::writeRaster(predicted_class_idx,
                   "../outputs/spatial/series_predicted_class_hybrid_rk.tif",
                   overwrite = TRUE)
write.csv(series_lookup_df,
          "../outputs/spatial/series_index_lookup.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("Rasters saved.\n")
```

```{r visualize}
print(p_val)
ggsave("../outputs/spatial/predicted_series_validation_hybrid.png",
       p_val, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 200)

# 4. Variable importance
rf_engine <- rf_final_hybrid %>% extract_fit_engine()
importance_df <- tibble(
  variable   = names(rf_engine$variable.importance),
  importance = rf_engine$variable.importance
) %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = fct_reorder(variable, importance),
    source   = if_else(str_detect(variable, "^\\.pred_"),
                       "NCSS probability", "Spatial covariate")
  )

p_imp <- ggplot(importance_df %>% slice_head(n = 25),
                aes(x = importance, y = variable, fill = source)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("NCSS probability"   = "#d73027",
                               "Spatial covariate"  = "#2c7bb6")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Variable Importance — Hybrid Spatial RF",
       x = "Permutation Importance", y = NULL, fill = "Feature type")
print(p_imp)
ggsave("../outputs/spatial/variable_importance_hybrid.png",
       p_imp, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 200)
```
